spec.name: Halloween Pumpkin Bowling Lane
spec.description: A miniature dark oak bowling lane for Orange SMP Halloween, with recessed charcoal gutters, raised wooden edges and ivory end markings. Long, narrow, axis-aligned construction faces negative Z. No pumpkins, pins, text, stands or animation.

prompt: Miniature spooky oak bowling lane with dark gutters and ivory end markings. No pumpkin or pins. Long narrow form x0..16 y0..4 z0..32. Front negative Z. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
